items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE
items.summary: An unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) zero-day vulnerability, also tracked as APSB26-146, was actively exploited in the wild, abusing Magento's template system through PHP code injection. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this vulnerability, rated CVSS 10.0.

items.title: Unauthenticated unrestricted file upload (PolyShell)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any Magento or Adobe Commerce store via the REST API, leading to arbitrary code execution. The fix for this issue was included in the August 2026 isolated patch level.

items.title: Unauthenticated customer account takeover
items.summary: An unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVSS 9.1) allows an attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining access to the victim's account and private customer data. This vulnerability was addressed as part of Adobe Security Bulletin APSB26-92.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update addresses vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium that could result in arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to the October Isolated patch file.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe also noted that the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 should be applied in addition to the security updates released in this bulletin.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) and other flaws leading to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. Adobe released these fixes as isolated patch files.
